tasks.brief: Implement src/services/llm.py: Define constant FALLBACK_REPLY = 'The language model is currently unavailable. Please try again in a moment.' Define function stream_reply(message: str) -> Iterator[tuple]. Inside stream_reply, read LLM_ENDPOINT, LLM_MODEL, LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT, LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS from os.environ at call time (defaults: 'http://localhost:1234/v1/chat/completions', 'local-model', '', 120). Construct upstream request body: {"model": LLM_MODEL, "messages": ([{"role": "system", "content": LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT}] if LLM_SYSTEM_PROMPT else []) + [{"role": "user", "content": message}], "stream": true}. Use httpx.Client() with timeout=float(LLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) for streaming POST to LLM_ENDPOINT. Parse SSE-framed response chunks line-by-line. For each chunk with non-empty choices[0].delta.content, yield ("token", content). On upstream data: [DONE] line with ≥1 prior token yields, yield ("done",). On any failure mode (connect error, timeout-to-first-byte, non-2xx, malformed/unparseable line, EOF without [DONE], or clean-but-empty completion with zero tokens), yield ("error",) as the only or final chunk. No exceptions escape stream_reply; all failures are represented as ("error",) chunks. Do not export generate_reply or any other symbols. Acceptance: stream_reply('test') with mocked httpx streaming 200 response yielding token chunks then [DONE] yields tokens in order followed by done; with connection error yields only error; with non-2xx yields only error; with timeout yields only error; with malformed chunk after tokens yields error after tokens; with [DONE] but zero prior tokens yields only error. Config is read at call time.

tasks.brief: Modify src/static/index.html: Replace fetch/render logic to handle streaming SSE responses. On form submit, call fetch POST /api/v1/chat with {"message": <text>}. Read response.body as a stream and parse SSE frames. For event: token, extract content from data JSON and append to chat display live. For event: done, finalize the stream (no more content expected). For event: error, append FALLBACK_REPLY text to chat display. Handle connection errors gracefully (show fallback). Acceptance: Page loads with GET / serving index.html; form submit triggers streaming fetch; token events append content live; done event finalizes; error event shows fallback text.
